runs.title: What's in McDonald's 2026 Disney Villains Boo Buckets?
runs.prompt: Today is Friday, October 16, 2026. McDonald's 2026 Halloween Boo Buckets have just been revealed, and reports say this year's buckets feature Disney Villains. A shopper wants the basics: (1) exactly which Disney Villains/characters are in the 2026 Boo Buckets set, (2) what date the buckets become available at McDonald's, and (3) what you must buy or pay to get one. Find the answers from public, non-paywalled pages and report them.
runs.answer: McDonald's 2026 Halloween Boo Buckets feature five Disney Villains: Jafar (Aladdin), Ursula (The Little Mermaid), Scar (The Lion King), Cruella de Vil (One Hundred and One Dalmatians) and Maleficent (Sleeping Beauty). They go on sale starting Tuesday, Oct. 20, 2026, at participating restaurants for a limited time, while supplies last. You get one by purchasing a Happy Meal — the Boo Bucket replaces the usual Happy Meal box (order a "Boo Bucket Meal" in-restaurant or via the McDonald's app; entrée choices are a hamburger, add-cheese burger, or 4- or 6-piece Chicken McNuggets, plus drink, apple slices and fries). There is no separate flat price: the bucket's cost is folded into the meal and is set by each individual restaurant, so prices vary by location.
